scope: Read-only descriptive holdout analysis after all model calls. Four distinct failed cases in two projects, repeated at three paired seeds; twelve case-runs per arm are not twelve independent cases. Raw candidates are unchanged. Cost per successful repair is undefined when none pass.
interpretation: Every arm has zero verified repairs on all four distinct held-out failures; reporting budget-only progress as repair success would be misleading.
Source v2 reduces input tokens relative to legacy source under the same maximum call and generated-token budgets. Neither generic nor categorized feedback establishes a success-rate benefit.

The generic-feedback and categorized-feedback v2 arms each have eight example exceptions and twenty-eight behavior-check failures; changing the failure stage is not equivalent to passing the independent checks.
One v2 first-request triplet has different candidate code despite identical model, payload and seed. No history was sent yet, so this variation cannot be attributed to feedback.
Three seeds repeat the same four cases; sample size is four distinct failures in two projects, not twelve independent tasks per arm.
